name: CUSTODES: TELEMON HEAVY DREADNOUGHT
description:
Telemon Dreadnoughts are each intended to stand sentinel over their charges, no matter the forces brought against them. With fewer than a handful of Telemon Dreadnoughts remaining, the honour of interment in one of the few existing Telemon sarcophagi is awarded to only the most celebrated warriors. Rare is the foe who can stand against the array of esoteric, handcrafted weapons that grace its chassis or the ferocious will and warrior skill of the master Custodian interred within.

Guardian Eternal

This multipart plastic kit builds 1 Telemon Heavy Dreadnought for Legio Custodes armies in games of Warhammer: The Horus Heresy and Adeptus Custodes armies in Warhammer 40,000. Boasting masterwork levels of protective technology, paired with superior Custodes weaponry, the Telemon is a truly terrifying adversary on the battlefield, blasting foes apart from afar and crushing them up close in melee.

Towering Dominance

This massive war-machine is equipped with a shoulder-mounted Spiculus Bolt Launcher and Dual Caestus Fists with Twin Neutronium Cascade Projectors, one of which can be replaced with a flexible Iliastus Accelerator Culverin, a high-damage Adrathic Desolator, or an armour-ruining Arachnus Storm Cannon.

The Telemon Dreadnought is highly customisable, as its legs can be posed in different positions, along with the elbows and fingers of each Caestus Fist. You can also choose from one of 2 waist armour designs, 2 helmet bases, and 3 helmet crowns.

Contents:
– 148 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 100mm Round Base
– 1 Legio Custodes Dreadnought Transfer Sheet
– 1 construction guide

The Legio Custodes Dreadnought Transfer Sheet features 165 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include Custodian symbols, text for locations of great battles, and more to decorate your miniature.

This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
